name: Outreachy Open Source Internship
reward: Paid three-month remote internship with experienced community mentors
summary: Global remote open-source internships for applicants who face underrepresentation, systemic bias, or discrimination in their local technical industry.
eligibility: Eligibility is identity- and circumstance-based; self-assess against the official applicant guide before applying. The December 2026 round is expected to open in early August.
